description: Listing all atoms occurring in a finite CNF and deleting repetitions gives a supporting atom list whose length equals the cardinality of the support.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.support_input.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Supported
      (List.map Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropLiteral.atom (List.flatten Γ)).eraseDups Γ ∧
    (List.map Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropLiteral.atom (List.flatten Γ)).eraseDups.length =
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.support Γ).card
